review_role: independent coding agent; separate from original implementation author

findings.description: A superseded job permanently consumed its trigger signature after exact evidence restoration, preventing resumed qualitative monitoring.
findings.fix: Resolve only superseded jobs via deterministic signature chain; each retry freezes a fresh packet at current as_of/queue_saved_at and links supersedes_job_id. Never rewrite prior job/attempt or bypass current evidence checks.

checks.evidence: register exact retry retains original version; new config requires latest version; company/issue/synthetic immutable; complete advances version without config revision.
Queue, claim and complete delegate source DAG, historical/current publicity, actual availability and classification checks; pending source snapshot SHA is checked against saved immutable source.
Source arriving during lease remains outside frozen packet; next queue only includes unreviewed source after prior completion.
New packets freeze prior result summary/observation/hash/chronology for same case version; mismatched historical result fences claim; old packets do not receive reconstructed prior fields.
Harness claim shares one active lease per company across intake and review; excluded companies do not queue or complete.
Completion reloads under write transaction, checks owner/attempt/unexpired lease; old same-name worker generation cannot complete new generation.
Case version, result, job completion and attempt journal share transaction/savepoints; injected journal failure is rolled back.
Exact completed request returns original result; changed result is rejected; completed financial records are not created.
Existing active/completed trigger does not consume new-job limit; candidate ordering and deferred count remain unchanged by fix.
Worker view deepcopies frozen case/new source content and source SHA; it omits large proof text by reference, preserves original packet and marks completion authorization unchecked.
Result requires exact five fields; no generated valuation/action/thesis/classification/IR dispatch/order calls; financial_inputs_verified and meaning_review_verified remain false.

QR-REQUEUE-01 reproduced and fixed: only superseded chain admits fresh packet; old packets/jobs/attempts untouched, retained evidence holds continue to reject, repeated pending/leased polling does not duplicate.

verification.prior_full_suite_1421: Reported by parent before review; not independently rerun by this reviewer. Parent will run full suite after fix.

limits: Manual code review plus focused regression tests is not a proof of all possible behavior.
Direct database corruption, arbitrary packet rewriting and concurrent hostile filesystem replacement are not certified.
This review checks workflow contracts, not financial semantics, author independence, investment quality, full-document reading or realized returns.
Full-suite acceptance and real database application are delegated to the parent; no claims that tests write the production database.
